meta.description: One workflow handles all 7 Country Cove businesses. Runs daily at 11PM ET. Gets video from Drive, generates AI caption, uploads to Cloudinary (permanent URL), posts via Odoo Social Marketing. Tracks posted files to prevent duplicates. Sends WhatsApp summary to Sachin after each run.
